summary: Packaged automatic updates have a credential-free updater runtime dry-run, but general release remains blocked until macOS and Windows packaged artifacts have device install, update, retry, rollback, launch, and preservation evidence.
preservationRequirements: Rollback may replace only packaged app binaries and release metadata.
Rollback must preserve generated workspaces and operator files.
Rollback must not read, rewrite, or delete Codex/OpenAI/GitHub credentials, browser cookies, local capability tokens, or environment secrets.
Credential preservation checks must use metadata-only no-read snapshots for credential paths.

deviceRuns.blocker: Signed macOS package artifacts and device update/rollback evidence are not available in the credential-free local environment.
requiredEvidence: macOS packaged artifact install reaches local first screen
update prompt supports user consent and deferral
failed update can retry without deleting the existing installation
rollback after failed launch restores previous app binary/release metadata
local DB, generated workspace, support bundle, operator files, and credentials are preserved
updater runtime touches only app binary, release metadata, and update state

when this run is passed, evidenceBundle includes device profile metadata, package kind, version transition, package/manifest/update/rollback/launch/preservation evidence refs, metadata-only credential snapshot mode, per-check evidence refs, protected-path evidence refs, redaction refs, and passed checks
unblockCriteria: Attach redacted macOS install/update/retry/rollback/launch evidence to #267
Keep pnpm verify:release-channel passing with final macOS packaged artifact metadata
